segments.he: הָאִישׁ מְקַדֵּשׁ אֶת בִּתּוֹ כְּשֶׁהִיא נַעֲרָה. כְּשֶׁהִיא נַעֲרָה – אִין, כְּשֶׁהִיא קְטַנָּה – לָא. מְסַיַּיע לֵיהּ לְרַב, דְּאָמַר רַב יְהוּדָה אָמַר רַב וְאִיתֵּימָא רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר: אָסוּר לְאָדָם שֶׁיְּקַדֵּשׁ אֶת בִּתּוֹ כְּשֶׁהִיא קְטַנָּה, עַד שֶׁתִּגְדַּל וְתֹאמַר: ״בִּפְלוֹנִי אֲנִי רוֹצָה״.
segments.en: The mishna teaches: «A man can betroth his daughter» to a man «when she is a young woman.» The Gemara infers: «When she is a young woman, yes,» he can betroth her; «when she is a minor, no,» he cannot betroth her. This statement «supports» the opinion of «Rav, as Rav Yehuda says» that «Rav says, and some say» it was said by «Rabbi Elazar: It is prohibited for a person to betroth his daughter» to a man «when she is a minor, until» such time «that she grows up and says: I want» to marry «so-and-so.» If a father betroths his daughter when she is a minor and incapable of forming an opinion of the husband, she may later find herself married to someone she does not like.
